description: This is a Perl module that provides a class for storing Memoize cache data in a YAML file. It ties a hash to a YAML file, supporting load on initialization and dump on destruction, to persist cache data in a YAML format.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Memoize::YAML
classes.description: A Perl class implementing a tied hash interface to store and retrieve data from a YAML file for Memoize caching.

methods.name: TIEHASH
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the tied hash, loading data from the YAML file if it exists.

methods.name: STORE
methods.description: Stores a value in the hash, updating the in-memory representation.

methods.name: FETCH
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the hash.

methods.name: EXISTS
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the hash.

methods.name: DESTROY
methods.description: Dumps the current hash data to the YAML file upon object destruction.

methods.name: SCALAR
methods.description: Returns the number of key-value pairs in the hash.

methods.name: FIRSTKEY
methods.description: Provides a fake hash key for iteration purposes.

methods.name: NEXTKEY
methods.description: Placeholder for hash key iteration; returns undef.
